svg.title: Kernel elapsed time trend: median milliseconds over recorded runs by scenario and runtime
svg.desc: Trend lines and points show median elapsed time in milliseconds across recorded runs from oldest (left) to newest (right). Lower means faster. Each zero-based linear scale uses the latest 10 runs or 25% of panel runs, rounded up, whichever is fewer, with 20% headroom. Upward triangles mark values above the scale; compact summaries give their ranges. Each marker retains its run and timing in its title. Failed or unavailable results have no point.

g.text: 20261026T042455.543890Z · 46 recorded runs · 3 samples per runtime and scenario
Lower points are faster · Linear axes start at zero · Oldest run on left, latest on right
